fact: The Direction générale de la modernisation de l'état civil trained delegated officers and transcribing agents in Pouni on the VENEEM platform for real-time entry of births, marriages and deaths, funded by PREGOLS for 2026.
The same session covered real-time entry of deaths, alongside births and marriages, on VENEEM at central and secondary registration offices, per the Agence d'Information du Burkina.
The Minister of Territorial Administration said 30 communes of Burkina Faso now hold fully digitised civil-status registers, reported by the Primature.

The SNEC steering committee chair said that in 2024 the IT solution for systematic declaration of civil-status events was deployed in 20 main and 96 secondary centres, with 22 main centres networked and 3,391,907 records of 54 communes digitised.
system: solution informatique de déclaration systématique des faits d'Etat civil

fact: AMADE Mondiale lists deployment of a digital birth registration platform and health-registry interoperability among completed activities of its 2025-2028 project in Kaya, Tenkodogo and Koupela.

The Ministry of Territorial Administration and Mobility launched on 12 November 2024 the pilot phase of the integrated civil-status management system (VENEEM) in Ouagadougou arrondissement 3, after testing in Komsilga and Ouagadougou since June 2024.
